0022600142.text: The Mavericks host the Thunder in their fifth game of the season, sitting at 2-2 and seventh in the West, while Oklahoma City is 4-0, leads the West, and is on a four-game winning streak. Dallas is without Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic, and Naji Marshall and Sergio de Larrea are listed as day-to-day. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh and Thomas Sorber, with Alex Caruso and Chet Holmgren also day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost all three games, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
